Fair-comparison note

Jev returns native probabilities. Qwen3 30B A3B and DeepSeek V4 Flash return schema-constrained labels and booleans, so repeated runs measure stability but do not create calibrated probabilities. Final routing should still combine extracted signals with your internal leaderboard, policy, cost, and latency in deterministic code.
